lines.start: Mrs. Flurry packs a snowball, bigger and bigger! She's feeling everything at once!
lines.puffing: Mrs. Flurry's snowball gets even bigger!
lines.fizzle: Flump! The giant snowball crumbles, and not one flies.

lines.intro: Mrs. Flurry, the lodge keeper, spins round with swirly eyes. "NOBODY gets in MY lodge!"
lines.command: How can Fae calm Mrs. Flurry?

soothe.great: Fae hums a cozy fireside song, slow and soft. Mrs. Flurry's swirly eyes start to slow down!
soothe.good: Fae hums softly. Mrs. Flurry stops packing snowballs for a moment.
soothe.miss: Mrs. Flurry cackles right over Fae's humming.

play.great: Maddie chases a snowflake round and round. Mrs. Flurry follows it, giggling!
play.good: Maddie pounces on a pom-pom. Mrs. Flurry chuckles.
play.miss: Maddie skids on the ice and tumbles into a snowbank. Mrs. Flurry snorts.

cast.great: Sue swings her ribbon bobber like a ski-lift chair. Mrs. Flurry cheers as it loops the loop!
cast.good: Sue's bobber twirls in the falling snow. Mrs. Flurry leans in to watch.
cast.miss: Sue's line tangles in a pine branch. Mrs. Flurry shakes her head.

juggle.great: Jordan juggles three pinecones in a perfect loop. "Bravo!" Mrs. Flurry claps.
juggle.good: Jordan tosses a pinecone high. Mrs. Flurry's eyes follow it up and down.
juggle.miss: Jordan's pinecone plops into a snowbank. Mrs. Flurry doesn't even look.

lines.snack: Fae shares a crunchy cracker. Mrs. Flurry munches it between snowballs.
lines.burst: Mrs. Flurry winds up and flings a flurry of snowballs at Fae!

burstResult.great: Fae catches every snowball, like a pro!
burstResult.good: Fae catches most of the snowballs!
burstResult.miss: Splat! Fae is covered in snow from her hat to her boots.

lines.soothed: Mrs. Flurry blinks. The swirls fade from her eyes, and the snowball slips from her hand.
lines.rest: Fae is shivering from all the snow. Time for a rest.
lines.run: Fae backs away. Mrs. Flurry packs another snowball.
